sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 9 · Herbalist’s shop
read: Broken bottles and unreadable books fill an old shop.

Glass fragments and damaged pages share the floor beneath the shelving. You can examine one storage place at a time rather than overturn the whole room. If someone has given you a description to follow, you can compare it with what you actually see here.

brief: Ruined herb/alchemy shop, sagging storage shelves, broken furniture, glass and pottery shards among weeds and rubble, rotted books and casks. The hidden necklace case stays beneath shelves and INVISIBLE. Daylight, no living herbalist, intact glowing potion shop or emerald display.
